steps.question: Do the 10 blood samples (5 subjects x control/treated) cluster by subject and by condition, and is there any outlier or mislabeled pair before modeling treatment effect?

PCA plot on top 500 variable genes colored by condition and by subject
Sample-to-sample Euclidean distance heatmap produced

Report explicitly states whether subject pairing looks consistent with metadata.csv

steps.name: Low-count pre-filter and paired DESeq2 differential expression
steps.question: Which genes are differentially expressed between treated and control samples within each of the 5 subjects (design ~subject + condition), using median-of-ratios normalization built into DESeq2?

grounding.reason: Paired n=5 raw-count design: DESeq2 Wald test with design ~subject+condition (R-0011), minimal pre-filter (R-0002/R-0029), model-internal median-of-ratios normalization (R-0026), explicit reference level (R-0036), apeglm shrinkage (R-0009), BH+independent filtering at alpha 0.05 (R-0010/R-0043), outlier-NA reporting at n=5 (R-0039), fit diagnostics and p-value histogram (R-0087/R-0083).

acceptance_criteria: Genes filtered to those with >=10 counts in >=5 samples (smallest group size) before modeling
DESeq2 dataset built with design ~subject + condition, subject and condition as factors from metadata.csv
Condition reference level explicitly set to 'control' (or the labeled control level) before fitting
Wald test run on the condition coefficient; contrast named explicitly as treated vs control
apeglm shrinkage applied to the condition log2FoldChange for reporting/ranking; unshrunken LFC, shrunken LFC, and lfcSE all retained in the output table
Count outliers (Cook's distance, n=5/group) flagged and the count of NA-p-value genes from this cause reported separately from independent-filtering NAs
MA plot and dispersion plot produced as fit diagnostics
P-value histogram inspected and its shape reported before adjustment
BH-adjusted p-values (padj) computed with independent filtering at alpha=0.05; number of genes tested and number of DE genes (padj<0.05) reported

steps.name: edgeR quasi-likelihood cross-check
steps.question: Does an edgeR quasi-likelihood F-test on the same ~subject+condition design and same filtered count matrix corroborate the DESeq2 treated-vs-control calls?

grounding.reason: n=5/group fixed-effects design: edgeR QL F-test as the second method for a robustness check (R-0001); report the DESeq2/edgeR intersection as the high-confidence set, not the union (R-0042).

acceptance_criteria: Same filtered gene set and design (~subject + condition) used as in the DESeq2 step
TMM normalization applied via edgeR calcNormFactors
glmQLFit and glmQLFTest run for the condition contrast
Number of significant genes (FDR<0.05) from edgeR reported
Overlap (intersection) between DESeq2 padj<0.05 genes and edgeR FDR<0.05 genes reported as the high-confidence set; genes unique to each method listed separately
Union is not presented as the result

steps.name: Preranked GSEA against Hallmark and Reactome gene sets
steps.question: Which biological pathways/processes are coordinately shifted by treatment across subjects, ranking all tested genes by the DESeq2 Wald statistic?

grounding.reason: Disputed rank-metric choice (R-0007) resolved as the DESeq2 Wald statistic per R-0099; Hallmark then Reactome as first/second human collections (R-0048/R-0098), both staged locally (MSigDB Hallmark 2026.1, Reactome current); full ranked list, no threshold cut (R-0045); size window 15-500 and redundancy collapse (R-0047/R-0052); leading-edge reporting (R-0105); short significant-list caveat (R-0103) applies only if T2S1 yields <50 DE genes.

acceptance_criteria: Full list of tested genes (post pre-filter) ranked by the DESeq2 Wald statistic ('stat' column) from T2S1 — no pre-thresholding by padj or fold change
fgsea run against MSigDB Hallmark human gene sets (50 sets) as the primary collection
fgsea run against Reactome human gene sets as the secondary collection, restricted to Homo sapiens via the Reactome pathway index
Gene sets restricted to 15-500 members among the tested genes before testing
BH adjustment applied to enrichment p-values
Redundant/overlapping significant sets collapsed to representative sets; full table kept as supplement
Leading-edge genes reported for each significant set with their Wald statistic
Gene set collection names and versions (Hallmark 2026.1, Reactome current release) stated in the output
If fewer than ~50 genes reach padj<0.05 in T2S1, report list size and note that only the ranked (preranked GSEA) result is used, not an over-representation test

steps.name: Consolidated differential expression and enrichment report
steps.question: What is the full, reproducible summary of genes and pathways responding to treatment within subjects, with all methods, thresholds, diagnostics, and versions stated?

grounding.reason: Report bundles method/version/design/threshold statement (R-0041), shrunken+unshrunken LFC table (R-0085), fit diagnostics (R-0087), enrichment reporting standards and method-dependence caveat (R-0051/R-0055), leading-edge genes (R-0105), and full reproducibility record (R-0086).

acceptance_criteria: Report states the design formula (~subject + condition), the reference level, and the named contrast (treated vs control)
Report states package versions (DESeq2, apeglm, edgeR, fgsea) and the gene-set collection versions used
Report includes MA plot and dispersion plot from T2S1
Gene table includes unshrunken log2FC, apeglm-shrunken log2FC, lfcSE, and padj for every tested gene, ranked by shrunken log2FC
Report states number of genes tested after filtering and number of DE genes at padj<0.05
Report includes the DESeq2/edgeR overlap table from T2S2
Report includes fgsea Hallmark and Reactome results with leading-edge genes and states that enrichment results are method-dependent
Reproducibility record included: sessionInfo, random seeds used, gene set collection versions

plan.title: Paired DESeq2 treatment-vs-control DE + pathway enrichment
plan.analytical_narrative: Five subjects each contribute a control and a treated blood sample (paired design, raw STAR/featureCounts integer gene counts, 12000 genes x 10 samples). The research question — which genes respond to treatment within each subject — calls for a within-subject (blocked) differential expression test that removes between-subject variance rather than a naive unpaired comparison. The plan follows the Inflexa-grounded procedure for a paired, n=5, raw-count, human bulk RNA-seq design: (1) sample-structure QC with a blind VST/PCA/distance-heatmap to confirm subjects pair as expected and to catch swaps or outliers before modeling; (2) a minimal low-count pre-filter (>=10 counts in >=5 samples, the smallest group size); (3) DESeq2 with design ~subject + condition, size-factor (median-of-ratios) normalization built into the model, and a Wald test on the condition coefficient — the design formula puts subject first so the condition effect is estimated within each subject; (4) apeglm shrinkage of the condition log2 fold change for reporting/ranking, with count-outlier flags (Cook's distance, n=5 per cell so NA-flagging applies) reported explicitly; (5) BH-adjusted significance at padj<0.05 with independent filtering, plus a p-value histogram diagnostic; (6) an edgeR quasi-likelihood F-test on the identical ~subject+condition design as a robustness cross-check, reporting the DESeq2/edgeR overlap as the high-confidence gene set; (7) preranked fgsea against MSigDB Hallmark (primary) then Reactome (secondary, both staged locally) using the DESeq2 Wald statistic as the ranking metric, since >=50 significant genes cannot be assumed a priori and a ranked test is the only method valid regardless of list size; (8) a consolidated report bundling fit diagnostics (MA plot, dispersion plot), the DE gene table (unshrunken and shrunken LFC, padj), the DESeq2/edgeR overlap, and the enrichment results with leading-edge genes and full reproducibility metadata (session info, seeds, gene-set collection versions).
